content.text:
Let me analyze this ticket.

Employee Keith Mclaughlin (E032) requests write access to Source Code.

There are two notes:
- HR note: role Analyst, full_time employee, recommends write for Source Code.
- Security note: contractor with basic security training, recommends read. Security DB is authoritative for employment type per the note.

The policy:
1. full_time employees: up to write. Admin only if role owns system.
2. contractor employees: read, or write if they have advanced security training. Never admin.

The conflict: HR says full-time, Security says contractor with basic training. Security says their DB is authoritative. The team memory says the Security agent looked up employment type in own database, while HR note 1 says looked up in own database before writing. The security note says "Security DB is authoritative here."

So the employment type is contractor with basic security training. Max access = read. Requested write > max, so grant max = read.

I'll submit decision: read.
